title: Faithful Generative Modeling for Censored Time-to-Event Data: From Distributional Fidelity to Statistical Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.25464v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Synthetic data has emerged as a powerful tool for data sharing, clinical trial simulation, and digital twin development, with growing applications in biomedical research and drug development. However, limited attention has been devoted to synthetic time-to-event data, which are central to clinical trials and survival analysis. In particular, theoretical guarantees for the distributional fidelity of synthetic survival data remain largely unexplored. More importantly, even when a generator achieves distributional fidelity, it remains unclear whether the downstream statistical analysis is reliable. To address these gaps, we propose a general two-stage generative framework for survival data (TSGSurv) that jointly generates observed times and covariates conditional on event status, and establish its distributional convergence rate. translated_title: 面向删失生存时间数据的忠实生成建模：从分布保真度到统计推断
translated_abstract: 合成数据已成为数据共享、临床试验模拟和数字孪生开发的有力工具，在生物医学研究和药物研发中的应用日益广泛。然而，针对生存时间数据的合成研究却鲜有关注，而这类数据正是临床试验和生存分析的核心。尤其是，合成生存数据分布保真度的理论保证在很大程度上仍属空白。更为重要的是，即使生成器达到了分布保真度，其下游统计分析是否可靠仍不清楚。为弥补这些空白，我们提出了一个通用的生存数据两阶段生成框架，该框架在事件状态的条件下联合生成观测时间和协变量，并建立了其分布收敛速度。聚焦于广泛使用的Cox比例风险模型，我们建立了生成器保真度（在此条件下……）（注：摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TSGSurv——一个通用的生存数据两阶段生成框架，在事件状态条件下联合生成观测时间和协变量，不仅建立了分布收敛速度，还为Cox比例风险模型下下游统计推断的可靠性提供了理论保证条件。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes TSGSurv, a general two-stage generative framework for survival data that jointly generates observed times and covariates conditional on event status, establishing distributional convergence rates and theoretical conditions under which downstream statistical inference via the Cox proportional hazards model is reliable.
